title: User Registration and Account Creation
description: New users must be able to create an account by providing their full name, a unique email address, a secure password, and an optional phone number. The system must validate all inputs in real-time, enforce password complexity rules, send an email verification link within 60 seconds, and prevent duplicate registrations. The registration page must be accessible without authentication and support both desktop and mobile viewports.
acceptance_criteria: Email must be unique across the system; Password must be minimum 8 characters with at least 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 digit, and 1 special character; Verification email sent within 60 seconds; Unverified accounts cannot log in; Duplicate email registration shows inline error; Phone number is optional but must match E.164 format if provided; Registration form retains data on validation failure except password fields

title: User Login with Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Authenticated access requires users to log in with their verified email and password. Upon successful credential validation, if MFA is enabled the system must trigger a 6-digit TOTP code prompt. The system must lock the account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts for 30 minutes, log all authentication events with IP address and timestamp, and redirect users to their originally requested URL after successful login.
acceptance_criteria: Valid credentials with MFA disabled redirects to dashboard; Valid credentials with MFA enabled prompts TOTP screen; Incorrect TOTP code shows error and allows 3 retries; Account locks after 5 failed password attempts; Locked account shows lockout duration message; All login events logged with user ID, IP address, timestamp, and outcome; Session token expires after 30 minutes of inactivity; Redirect to originally requested URL after login

title: Password Reset via Secure Email Link
description: Users who have forgotten their password must be able to initiate a reset by entering their registered email. The system sends a secure time-limited token link to the email. Clicking the link opens a password reset form. The new password must meet complexity requirements. The old password must be invalidated immediately upon successful reset. The reset link must expire after 24 hours or first use, whichever comes first.
acceptance_criteria: Reset email delivered within 60 seconds; Link expires after 24 hours; Link is single-use — second click shows expiry message; New password cannot be same as current password; All active sessions invalidated on password reset; Confirmation email sent after successful reset; Invalid or expired link shows clear error message; Reset request for non-existent email shows generic success message to prevent enumeration

title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with Permission Inheritance
description: The system must implement a three-tier RBAC model: SuperAdmin, Manager, and User. SuperAdmin can create/edit/delete all entities and manage roles. Manager can manage their team members and view reports. User can only access their own profile and assigned tasks. Permissions must be checked server-side on every API call. Role changes must take effect immediately without requiring re-login.
acceptance_criteria: SuperAdmin can access all system endpoints; Manager cannot access system settings or other teams' data; User cannot view other users' profiles or tasks; Server returns 403 for unauthorized access attempts; Role changes reflected in next API call without re-login; All unauthorized access attempts are logged; Role assignment requires SuperAdmin privileges; Permission checks happen server-side, not just in UI

title: Product Catalog with Advanced Search and Filtering
description: The product catalog must display all active products with name, description, price, stock status, category, and thumbnail image. Users must be able to search by keyword (with fuzzy matching), filter by category, price range, rating, and availability. Search results must be paginated (20 per page), sortable by price/rating/name/newest, and return results within 2 seconds for up to 10,000 products.
acceptance_criteria: Keyword search supports partial matches and fuzzy matching; Category filter supports multi-select; Price range filter accepts min and max values; Rating filter shows products at or above selected rating; Stock filter shows in-stock only option; Results paginated at 20 per page with total count shown; Sort options: price asc/desc, rating desc, name asc, newest first; Search response time under 2 seconds for catalog up to 10k products; Empty results shows helpful message with suggestions; URL reflects current filter/sort state for shareability

title: Shopping Cart with Persistent State
description: Authenticated users must be able to add products to a cart, update quantities, remove items, and apply discount codes. The cart must persist across browser sessions and devices for authenticated users. Guest carts must persist for 7 days via browser storage. On login, guest cart items must be merged with the authenticated cart. Cart must display real-time stock validation, subtotal, applied discounts, and estimated tax.
acceptance_criteria: Cart persists across browser close/reopen for authenticated users; Guest cart persists 7 days; Guest cart merges with auth cart on login (no duplicates); Adding out-of-stock item shows error and does not add; Quantity update reflects in subtotal immediately; Removing item prompts confirmation; Valid discount code applies percentage or fixed discount; Invalid discount code shows specific error message; Cart badge in header updates in real-time; Tax calculated based on user's shipping address

title: Multi-Step Checkout Process
description: The checkout must be a 3-step process: (1) Shipping address selection or entry, (2) Payment method selection and entry, (3) Order review and confirmation. Users must be able to save shipping addresses and payment methods for future use. The system must validate stock availability at order submission. Failed payments must not create orders. Successful orders must trigger confirmation email and inventory deduction atomically.
acceptance_criteria: Step 1: existing saved addresses shown; new address can be entered and optionally saved; Step 2: credit card, PayPal, and wallet balance supported; card details validated in real-time via Luhn algorithm; Step 3: full order summary shown before submission; Out-of-stock items flagged at order submission with option to remove; Payment failure shows specific error message and retains cart; Successful order creates order record, deducts inventory, sends confirmation email atomically; Confirmation page shows order number and estimated delivery date; Back navigation between steps retains entered data

title: Order Management and Real-Time Tracking
description: Users must be able to view all their orders with status, items, amounts, and tracking information. Order statuses are: Placed, Processing, Packed, Shipped, Out for Delivery, Delivered, Cancelled, Refund Requested, Refunded. Shipped orders must display a carrier tracking number and embedded map tracking. Users can cancel orders in Placed or Processing status. Cancellation triggers immediate refund initiation.
acceptance_criteria: Orders list shows all orders with status badge, date, total, and thumbnail of first item; Order detail shows all items, quantities, prices, shipping address, payment method; Tracking number shown when status is Shipped or later; Cancel button visible only for Placed and Processing orders; Cancellation requires confirmation dialog; Refund initiated within 5 minutes of cancellation confirmation; Email notification sent on every status change; Estimated delivery date shown and updated based on carrier data; Returns and refund requests accessible from delivered orders

title: Inventory Management with Low-Stock Alerts
description: Managers must be able to view, add, update, and deactivate products. Each product has SKU, name, description, category, price, cost, images (up to 10), stock quantity, reorder point, and active status. When stock falls below the reorder point, the system must send an email alert to all Managers. Bulk operations must support CSV import/export. All inventory changes must be logged with user, timestamp, and before/after values.
acceptance_criteria: Product list shows all products with search and filter by category/status; Product create form validates all required fields inline; SKU must be unique; Up to 10 images uploadable per product (max 5MB each, JPEG/PNG only); Low-stock email alert sent when quantity falls below reorder point; Alert not repeated more than once per 24 hours per product; Bulk CSV import validates each row and reports errors per row without stopping valid rows; All stock changes logged: who changed, when, old value, new value; Deactivated products hidden from catalog but order history preserved

title: Customer Reviews and Ratings System
description: Authenticated users who have purchased and received a product can submit a rating (1-5 stars) and optional text review (up to 1000 characters). Each user can submit only one review per product but can edit it within 30 days. Reviews must be moderated before display if they contain flagged words. The aggregate rating must update in real-time. Managers can respond to reviews publicly.
acceptance_criteria: Only users with a Delivered order for the product can review it; One review per user per product — edit allowed within 30 days; Text review optional but max 1000 chars; Reviews with flagged words enter moderation queue and show as pending to reviewer; Approved reviews show on product page within 5 minutes; Aggregate star rating updates immediately after approval; Manager response shows as verified seller reply below review; Report abuse button available on each review; Reviews sorted by: most recent, most helpful, highest/lowest rated

title: Real-Time Notification System
description: The system must deliver real-time in-app notifications for: new orders, order status changes, low stock alerts, new reviews, and system announcements. Notifications must be delivered via WebSocket when the user is online and stored for retrieval when offline. Each notification must have a type, message, timestamp, read status, and optional action link. Users must be able to mark notifications as read individually or all at once.
acceptance_criteria: WebSocket connection established on login; Notifications delivered within 2 seconds of triggering event; Unread notification count shown in header badge; Notifications persist for 90 days; Mark single notification as read on click; Mark all as read button clears badge; Notification panel paginated — 20 per load; Notification types have distinct icons; Action link navigates to relevant page; Offline notifications retrieved in chronological order on reconnect; Users can disable notification types in settings

title: Analytics Dashboard for Managers
description: Managers must have access to a dashboard showing: daily/weekly/monthly revenue trends, top 10 selling products, conversion funnel (visits → cart adds → purchases), customer acquisition by channel, average order value, and inventory health (stock levels vs reorder points). All metrics must be filterable by date range. Dashboard must load within 3 seconds and support data export to CSV.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard loads within 3 seconds on standard connection; Revenue chart supports daily/weekly/monthly toggle; Date range picker defaults to last 30 days with presets: today, 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, custom; Top 10 products table shows name, units sold, revenue, and trend; Conversion funnel shows percentage drop-off at each stage; Customer acquisition chart shows channels: organic, paid, referral, direct; Average order value shown with trend vs previous period; Inventory health table highlights products below reorder point in red; All tables exportable to CSV; Data refreshes every 5 minutes automatically

title: API Rate Limiting and Throttling
description: All public API endpoints must enforce rate limiting to prevent abuse. Unauthenticated requests: 100 per hour per IP. Authenticated requests: 1000 per hour per user. Search endpoints: 60 per minute per user. Payment endpoints: 10 per minute per user. Rate limit headers must be included in all responses. Exceeded limits must return HTTP 429 with retry-after header. Whitelisted IPs must bypass rate limiting.
acceptance_criteria: Rate limit headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset in every response; HTTP 429 returned when limit exceeded; Retry-After header shows seconds until reset; Unauthenticated IP limit: 100/hour; Authenticated user limit: 1000/hour; Search endpoint limit: 60/minute; Payment endpoint limit: 10/minute; Whitelisted IPs bypass all limits; Rate limit counters reset at the start of each window; Burst of 10 requests allowed above limit before throttling

title: Data Export and GDPR Compliance
description: Users must be able to request a full export of their personal data. The export must be generated asynchronously and delivered via email link within 24 hours. The export must include: account info, order history, reviews, saved addresses, and activity logs. Users must also be able to request account deletion, which anonymizes personal data while retaining order records for accounting. All data processing must comply with GDPR Article 17.
acceptance_criteria: Export request acknowledged immediately with email notification; Export file generated within 24 hours (target: 2 hours); Export delivered as password-protected ZIP containing JSON and CSV files; Export includes: profile, orders, reviews, addresses, login history; Download link expires after 7 days; Account deletion request requires email confirmation; Deletion anonymizes: name, email, phone, address (replaced with hashed values); Order records retained with anonymized user reference; Deletion processed within 30 days; User cannot log in after deletion; All data processing activities logged in audit trail

title: Search Autocomplete and Recommendations Engine
description: The search bar must provide real-time autocomplete suggestions after 2 characters are typed, showing up to 8 product name suggestions and 3 category suggestions, with results debounced at 300ms. The product detail page must show a 'Customers Also Bought' section with up to 6 recommendations based on collaborative filtering. The homepage must show personalized recommendations based on browsing and purchase history for authenticated users.
acceptance_criteria: Autocomplete triggers after 2 characters with 300ms debounce; Up to 8 product suggestions shown with thumbnail and price; Up to 3 category suggestions shown with icon; Suggestions highlight matching characters; Keyboard navigation supported (arrow keys, enter, escape); No results state shows 'Search for X' option; Recommendations on product page based on co-purchase data; Homepage recommendations personalized for authenticated users; Anonymous users see trending/popular products instead; Recommendations exclude already-purchased products; Clicking recommendation tracked for model improvement
